scope: Static review of storage, archivePolicy and artifactPolicy schema sections against runtime contracts; other schema sections are not yet fully reviewed
review_notes: Four root names match the runtime: workspaceRoot, objectRoot, releaseRoot and publicationRoot. Relative placement is project-root based; external placement requires absolute paths.
Archive mode enum, named external backend requirement and Git/LFS backend prohibition match archive_policy.resolve.
Budget and retention fields are nonnegative integers; formal delivery additionally requires explicit budget and archive policy in its original run snapshot.
Runtime exact Python integer checks remain authoritative for rejecting boolean or floating-point representations; JSON Schema alone does not prove record or lifecycle validity.
